questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select “No substitution”.

They thought she was arrogant, __and she was__ very shy.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**whereas she was**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **conjunction** '**and**' used is **incorrect **also the words "**arrogant and shy**" are **in contrast** with each other.
 
• Let us explore the given options__:
 __
 
• **As soon as** means **at the moment (that); when**.
 
• **So that** means **to show purpose or to give an explanation**.
 
• **And** is used **to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly**.
 
• **Whereas** means **in contrast or comparison with the fact that**.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct Sentence__: *They thought she was arrogant, **whereas** **she was** very shy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc6860af6f4718c1889a364603433dd6c44d3897a89b139b0c1c858601cb8c19.png] 

__
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, Conjunction ' and ' का प्रयोग गलत है , " arrogant और shy " शब्द एक दूसरे के साथ विपरीत हैं।
 
• आइए दिए गए विकल्पों का पता लगाएं__ :
 __
 
• As soon as इसका मतलब जब
 
• So that का मतलब उद्देश्य दिखाना या स्पष्टीकरण देना है ।
 
• And भाषण के एक ही हिस्से, खंड, या वाक्यों के शब्दों को जोड़ने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, जिन्हें संयुक्त रूप से लिया जाना है।
 
• Whereas का अर्थ है कि इसके विपरीत या तुलना ।
 
 
 
• इसलिए , सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: From the given options, identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

He not only got a scholarship and also a good job.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**and also**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the conjunction '**and**' used is **incorrect**. We know with "not only", we use "but also" in a sentence.
 
• "**Not only**" and "**but also**" are correlative conjunctions work in pairs to join words, phrases, or clauses.
 
• The construction "**not only....but also**" is called **correlative conjunction**. It is **used to present two related pieces of information**.
 
• **Both pieces of information** are being presented by the writer as **surprising or unexpected**, with the **second one being even more surprising than the first**.
 
• The **first piece of information** comes **after** **not only**, and the **second piece of information** comes **after but also**.
 
• **Hence**, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence__: ***He not only got a scholarship **but also** a good job.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Correlative conjunctions** work in pairs to join words, phrases, or clauses. The correlative conjunctions are **either...or, neither...nor, both...and, not only...but also, whether...or.**

questions.question:
**Directions: From the given options, identify the segment in the sentence which contains the grammatical error.**

The T.V. and the computer has been blamed for reduced reading habits amongst children.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "has been blamed".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the **subject of the sentence** is composed of **two nouns** "**The T.V. and the computer**" but **followed by a singular verb 'has'.**
 
• When the **subject of the sentence** is **composed of two or more nouns or pronouns connected by 'and'**, **use** a **plural verb**.
 
• Therefore, the **plural form of the verb** '**have**' should be used **instead of** '**has**'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct Sentence__: *The T.V. and the computer **have been blamed **for reduced reading habits amongst children.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

__
 
• **Subjects and verbs must agree with one another in number (singular or plural)**. Thus, if a subject is singular, its verb must also be singular; if a subject is a plural, its verb must also be plural.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिए गए वाक्य में, वाक्य का विषय दो संज्ञाओं **"The T.V. and the computer"** से बना है, लेकिन इसके बाद एकवचन क्रिया 'has' है।
 
• जब वाक्य का विषय '**and**' से जुड़े दो या दो से अधिक संज्ञा या सर्वनाम से बना हो, तो **बहुवचन क्रिया** का प्रयोग करें।
 
• इसलिए, क्रिया के बहुवचन रूप '**have**' का प्रयोग '**has**' के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2** है।

 

**सही वाक्य:** *The T.V. and the computer have been blamed for reduced reading habits amongst children.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• विषय और क्रिया एक दूसरे के साथ संख्या (एकवचन या बहुवचन) में सहमत होना चाहिए। इस प्रकार, यदि कोई विषय एकवचन है, तो उसकी क्रिया भी एकवचन होनी चाहिए; यदि कोई विषय बहुवचन है, तो उसकी क्रिया भी बहुवचन होनी चाहिए।

• भविष्य को व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले ‘**will not**’ का संकुचन **Won’t** होगा।
